title: New speaking opportunities: week 47, 2026
intro: Open calls for speakers we found and checked this week, ordered by deadline. Each listing links to the organiser's own call page.

items.title: BA & Beyond 27
items.event_dates: 18–28 May 2027 (seven locations, one day each; Sweden on 24 May)
items.country: Several (Luxembourg, Netherlands, Hungary, Romania, Sweden, Denmark, Belgium)
requirements: Real-life results from you or your team strongly preferred
No commercial presentations
Up to two topics; abstract with up to three key takeaways
Multi-stage process with follow-up questions
items.speaker_costs: Free to speak. One speaker per session gets a free pass to the whole event; co-speaker gets 50% off. Workshop facilitators get limited travel cover.

items.title: 2027 ISPE Nordic Affiliate Annual Meeting: Call for Proposals
topics: AI and digitalisation in regulated environments
requirements: Educational, practical and non-commercial; sales talks not considered
Cover challenge, approach, impact and takeaways
Open to professionals at all career stages
items.speaker_costs: Free for speakers. Other benefits not stated.

items.title: OCX 2027: Call for Proposals
requirements: Vendor-neutral: no promotional talks
Judged on clarity, relevance, originality and impact
First-time speakers welcome
Consent to recording and Code of Conduct
items.speaker_costs: Free conference pass and speaker dinner. Speakers pay their own travel and hotel.

items.title: Workplace Ninjas Norway 2027
topics: AI, Copilot and agents in IT
requirements: Technical community conference: real-world implementations and lessons
No sales presentations or product pitches
Live demos encouraged
items.speaker_costs: Free entry, one hotel night, economy travel up to EUR 400 (EUR 300 each for co-speakers).

items.title: EBAday 2027 Fintech Zone
requirements: For early-stage fintechs with a working product or proof of concept
Solution relevant to banking, payments or financial services
Written answers with word limits; company website and LinkedIn

items.title: Span Cyber Security Arena 2027
requirements: For security, risk and compliance professionals, regulators and technology leaders
Real-world case studies and lessons learned welcome
Decisions by 1 March 2027; sessions recorded

items.title: Workhuman Forum London (also Workhuman Webinars)
requirements: Video sample link required
Show tangible impact and actionable takeaways
Accepted speakers attend the whole event
No proposals by email
items.speaker_costs: For in-person events, registration and hotel covered.

items.title: Dynamics User Group Sweden: 21 April 2027
requirements: Title and description in Swedish first
Fill in target audience, product and level correctly
Speakers register for the event themselves

items.title: ISC2 Norway: Constant Call for Speakers
requirements: Abstract of 150–500 words with key takeaways
No marketing talks or product pitches
Agree to the Code of Conduct

items.title: HLTH Europe 2027: Become a Speaker
requirements: Bold perspectives from people at the frontier of healthcare innovation
Read the speaker guidelines before submitting

items.title: brightonSEO April 2027: Speaker Pitch
requirements: One specific, actionable idea per pitch
No self-promotion, product demos or basic tips
Rolling review; only successful speakers get a reply
items.speaker_costs: Free all-access ticket plus two passes, speaker training and mentoring.

method: How we compile this: we search organiser websites, Sessionize and the open conference-data project on GitHub for calls for speakers that were published or opened recently and are still open. Every listing is opened and checked on the organiser's page before it is included. "Posted" is the date the call opened or was published, where the organiser states it. Details can change, so always confirm on the call page before you apply. Some calls charge speakers; that is shown under Speaker costs.
